title: Slushie Bar Salts Vimbull Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Vimbull Ice by Slushie Bar Salts delivers the sumptuous taste of a classic Berry Cordial, enriched with the flavours of Blackberries, Blackcurrants, and Raspberries, all complemented by a hint of icy Menthol. This e-liquid perfectly captures the essence of dark and juicy berries, offering a deeply satisfying and rich fruit experience. Each inhale brings a burst of berry goodness, with the natural sweetness of Blackberries and Blackcurrants blending seamlessly with the slightly tart Raspberry notes. This delightful mix creates a multi-layered flavour profile that is both indulgent and refreshing. The addition of icy Menthol on the exhale provides a cool and crisp finish, enhancing the overall vaping experience and leaving a pleasantly refreshing aftertaste. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
